name: The Game Screen Fits the Phone
greenMarker: The game screen fits every size and font scale checked
note: BACKLOG U-1: a Galaxy S25 Ultra at a larger system font had the banner over the keypad. The first three mutations put back one of the three causes. The rest put back the ways the app failed to USE a tablet rather than fit on one (Diary ㊸): a width cap that stops growing with the window, the row of nine digits kept on a wide screen, and the stacked layout kept lying down. The last three (2026-10-21, D20) are about racing a ghost: every size is now measured with the rival banner too, which this gate never had.

mutations.name: the keypad may shrink again
mutations.why: A squeezed keypad cut its own digit row on a 360x640 screen while the page still fit.

mutations.name: the board goes back to full width
mutations.why: The original bug: a full-width square board pushed the keypad under the bottom banner (the page itself does not scroll — the screen is one screen tall — so the overlap is the symptom).

mutations.name: the keypad sits against the banner
mutations.why: Space below the keypad is what keeps a digit tap from landing on an ad.

mutations.name: the portrait cap stops growing
mutations.why: 680px was written for a desktop browser window. In the 1066px window a tablet held upright has, it is 64% of the screen and the board stops at 648px with a third of the screen empty under the keypad.

mutations.name: the digits stay in one row of nine
mutations.why: Nine across is the only shape that fits a phone. Lying down on a tablet it makes 46px keys in a column a thousand pixels tall, with the pad floating in the middle of it.

mutations.name: lying down, the keypad goes back under the board
mutations.why: Stacked in a landscape window the board is starved by a keypad taller than the window — a 780x380 split-screen half gave a 26px board.
mutations.expectFailure: keypad is still under the board

mutations.name: the 3x3 pad drops its height condition
mutations.why: Red-team finding. The pad is about three times the height of the row it replaces, so a wide LOW window cannot hold it: at 1280x480 — a tablet's split-screen half, and the minimum height the manifest declares — it ran 90px under the banner. Digit buttons on top of an ad is the report this gate exists for.

mutations.name: the 3x3 line goes back to 720
mutations.why: When the line was first drawn at 720 it held at the normal font and left 23px of clearance at 1.3x — one pixel under what this layout promises. Since then the cqh lock keeps the pad inside its column, so clearance no longer fails; what 720 breaks now is the shape: a 1280x720 window gets the 3x3 pad where the row of nine is what fits. Repointed 2026-09-30 when the full audit reported WRONG_REASON — the gate was right, the stated reason had gone stale. A 740 line passes, because no measured size sits between 720 and 760.

mutations.name: lying down, the ghost banner goes back into the row
mutations.why: D20. The banner was a third item beside the board and keypad; at 1280x720 the row came to 1435px with 1256 to give and ran off both sides. 8 of the 9 landscape sizes, both font scales.

mutations.name: the 3x3 pad's height lock forgets the ghost banner
mutations.why: D20. In a race the banner shares the 3x3 pad's column. Without giving up its room the column is taller than the board, and at 1280x760 the pad came 21px from the ad.

mutations.name: the ghost banner's 8px margin comes back
mutations.why: D20. The margin sat on top of .game-main's 14px gap. Counted (useBoardFit now measures the margin box) it costs the board 8px, and at 360x640 with a 1.3x font that is 196px — under the 200 this gate calls playable. Uncounted, as before, it cost the ad gap instead: 20px.

mutations.name: the game area's basis goes back to auto
mutations.why: D48 (2026-11-05). With `flex: 1 1 auto` the Android 15 emulator's WebView 124 gave 100cqh = 0 inside .game-main whenever the board had no 100%-tall child — the paused board — and it fell to its 14px padding with 「일시정지 · 눌러서 계속」 cut away. This gate's browser lays it out correctly, so only the source check can see it; the paused measurement passes either way.

mutations.name: the game area becomes flex: 1
mutations.why: D48. The shorthand looks like the fix but its basis is 0%, and on WebView 124 0% failed exactly like auto (measured live on the emulator).

mutations.name: the paused board takes its content's width
mutations.why: D48, the shape a current browser does show: the paused board has no grid, and the board is an inline-size container, so a width taken from its content is its padding — the same 14px the emulator drew.
